units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:21">Ab. IV, 21</cite> <he>הק׳ והתאוה וכ׳</he> jealousy, lust, and ambition carry man out of the world (v. <cite ref="J00515"><he>יָצָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21a">B. Bath. 21ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:1">22ᵃ</cite> <he>קִנְאַת סופרים וכ׳</he> emulation among scholars increases wisdom.
<cite ref="Megillah 7a:3">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ את מעוררת עלינו וכ׳</he> thou wilt arouse the envy of the nations against us.

<cite ref="Gittin 7a:11">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>קינה וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Joshua 15:22">Josh. XV, 22</cite>) <he>כל מי שיש לו ק̇' … וד̇ומ̇ס שוכן ע̇ד̇י ע̇ד̇ וכ׳</he> if a man has cause for anger against a fellowman and keeps silence, he who is enthroned for evermore will do justice to him.

<cite ref="Sotah 2b:28">Sot. 2ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="S01027"><he>קִינּוּי</he></cite>) <he>דבר המטיל ק׳ וכ׳</he> something which causes ill feeling between her and others (the witnesses that tell); <he>המטיל ק׳ בינו לבינה</he> which causes ill feeling between himself (the husband) and her.
<cite ref="Berakhot 33b:18">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מטיל ק׳ במעשה וכ׳</he> he causes jealousy among the works of creation (intimating that God’s love of his creatures is partial).

<cite ref="Shabbat 89a:1">Sabb. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ יש ביניכם</he> is there envy among you (the angels, that you must be warned not to commit murder &c.)? <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82a:11">B. Kam. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>מכניס … את הק׳</he> causes love to enter (into man’s heart) and ill-will to escape; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְנָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:22">Num. R. s. 9</cite>; a. e.
